verdict.rationale: LegalOS's own pages say attorneys work cases "paired with AI workflows" and that every petition gets licensed-attorney review before filing, so the human-check side is stated. However, it never says which parts of petition drafting or review are automated by AI. Missing for 10: an explicit breakdown of which drafting or review steps the AI performs, a description of what the attorney review checks for, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI and human split.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider states how it uses AI in petition drafting and review — what is automated, what a human attorney checks — on its own pages
